note: Inputs for the golden decoder outputs (scripts/golden.sh -> fixtures/golden/) and the docs-site playground. Every input is a committed fixture with its own provenance file. Scenarios marked deliberate combine real inputs on purpose to show a status; the title says so.

scenarios.title: USDC on mainnet, through the Stellar Asset Contract sidecar
scenarios.story: The built-in Stellar Asset Contract has no wasm, so it can never carry a section. A sidecar file describes it. Instance storage plus five contract-holder balances.

scenarios.title: A mainnet contract whose wasm carries no schema
scenarios.story: One of the USDC holders is a wasm contract without a contractstoragev0 section. This is every contract today: the decoder names nothing and says unknown for each entry, with the key shape.

scenarios.title: Deliberate: USDC balances read with the wrong schema
scenarios.story: The soroban-examples token stores Balance(Address) -> i128. The SAC stores Balance(Address) -> {amount, authorized, clawback}. Same key shape, different value: the decoder reports value_mismatch with the path, instead of a wrong decode.

scenarios.title: Token annotated with #[storage_schema]
scenarios.story: soroban-examples token with a one-attribute-per-variant diff. The schema travels inside the wasm; no other input is needed.

scenarios.title: Raw Symbol key with #[storage_key]
scenarios.story: soroban-examples increment stores a counter under symbol_short!("COUNTER") in instance storage.

scenarios.title: Unmodified OpenZeppelin token, schema injected after the build
scenarios.story: OZ stellar-contracts v0.8.0 fungible-pausable, not modified. A sidecar was written into the built wasm with storage-schema inject. Keys come from three crates; lib says which.

scenarios.title: The same OpenZeppelin token without a schema
scenarios.story: Identical entries, plain wasm. Without a schema nothing is named and nothing is guessed.

scenarios.title: OpenZeppelin keys declared in source with storage_schema_extern!
scenarios.story: A token built on OZ stellar-tokens 0.8.0. The keys OZ writes are declared with storage_schema_extern! in a separate library crate, so the schema is in the wasm straight from stellar contract build (SSC-013).

scenarios.title: Deliberate: two crates both claim Balance(Address)
scenarios.story: The token's schema merged with the OZ fungible sidecar, as when one contract links both crates (rs-soroban-sdk#2088). One ledger entry, two writers that could have meant it: the decoder reports ambiguous with both candidates and does not pick.
